h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jodhpur

items.pText: Jodhpur, the Blue City, sits on the edge of the Thar desert below Mehrangarh fort. Summers are long and extremely hot, rain is scarce and much of the ground around the city is sandy or rocky. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for schools, cantonment areas, hotels and housing colonies here from our factory in Vasai, about 770 km away, delivered by road.

Sand looks like a soft, natural surface for a play area, and in a desert town it is everywhere. In practice it causes trouble. Loose sand gets very hot by midday, blows onto slides and into bearings, and hides litter and sharp objects. It also shifts, so the level under a swing soon becomes a hollow. We usually suggest a firm, compacted base with rubber flooring on top. If you want sand play, keep it to a separate, shaded sand corner away from the main equipment.

richText.heading: Foundations and surfaces on sandy ground

c: Loose sand gives posts little grip, so we grout equipment on a proper concrete base set into firmer ground below. On rocky patches, pits may need to be cut into stone. Over the finished base, rubber flooring gives an even, cushioned surface that does not blow away and is quick to sweep. Brush sand off slides and platforms daily in the windy months, since grit scratches plastic and wears moving parts. Shade from trees or a pergola keeps surfaces usable through the long summer.

items.q: Is sand a good surface under playground equipment in Jodhpur?
items.a: Loose sand gets very hot, blows onto equipment and shifts under swings. A compacted base with rubber flooring stays level and comfortable to use, and it is easier to keep clean.

items.q: How do you anchor equipment in sandy soil?
items.a: We grout each post into a concrete base that reaches firmer ground, and on rocky patches the pits are cut into stone. Self-standing installation suits paved courtyards.

items.q: Do you supply hotels and schools in Jodhpur?
items.a: Yes. Hotels, schools, cantonment areas and housing colonies can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install with our own team or a dealer in Rajasthan.
